description: This file defines API endpoints for report management in a FastAPI application, including retrieving latest report metadata, exporting reports, and a placeholder for report download.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance for report endpoints

methods.name: _get_service
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of ReportsService, raises error if not initialized.

methods.name: set_reports_service
methods.description: Sets the singleton ReportsService used by the router.

methods.name: get_latest_report
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch the latest report metadata for a given test run ID.

methods.name: export_report
methods.description: Endpoint to queue a report export request.

methods.name: download_report_placeholder
methods.description: Placeholder endpoint for report download, returns a plain text message.
